name: Tranceweaver

bonuses.name: Allure of Slaanesh
bonuses.text: Attack Tests made against a Tranceweaver use Willpower as their Attribute - ranged attacks use Ballistic Skill (Wil), melee attacks use Weapon Skill (Wil).

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Herald of Slaanesh
bonuses.text: If any Daemonette is within Short Range of this Threat, they may re-roll any 1s on their attack rolls.

abilities.name: Disquieting Creature & Quicksilver Swiftness
abilities.text: Anyone that can see or hear a Tranceweaver must pass a DN 3 Fear Test. The Tranceweaver then acts first in the Initiative order as though they had Seized the Initiative

abilities.name: Exquisite Agonies
abilities.text: When this Threat rolls a Wrath Critical, its attacks gain the Agonising Trait.

abilities.name: Tranceweaver
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin and nominate a Mob of Daemonettes within 20 metres; Until Tranceweaver's next turn, that Mob's attacks gain a -1 bonus to their AP rating.

note: Allure of Slaanesh prints 'uses' (sic, after 'Attack Tests'). Battlecry has no closing full stop.
determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 6d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
